environment.description: Same Flask application deployed identically on EC2 behind ALB. The ALB is associated with an AWS WAFv2 Web ACL. The Web ACL contains a single rule group reference: a custom rule group 'corp-api-input-validation' with priority 1 and override action none. This custom rule group contains two rules: (1) 'size-constraint-qs' which applies a SizeConstraintStatement on QueryString with ComparisonOperator GT and Size 64, action BLOCK; (2) 'regex-pattern-qs' which applies a RegexPatternSetReferenceStatement on QueryString using pattern set 'ps-sqli-union-subselect' (patterns: '(?i)union[\s/\*]+select', '(?i)select[\s/\*]+.*from[\s/\*]+', "(?i)'[\s]*or[\s]*'") with TextTransformation URL_DECODE priority 0 and LOWERCASE priority 1, action BLOCK. Web ACL default action is ALLOW. CloudWatch metrics enabled for both rules with sampled requests.
